body:
I tried converting some COLLADA sample models of Khronos.
https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Models/tree/master/sourceModels

|Model Name|Command|Result|
|:-------------|:-------|:-------|
|[BoxAnimated.dae](https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Models/tree/master/sourceModels/BoxAnimated)  |`assimp export BoxAnimated.dae BoxAnimated.glb -glb2`|:white_check_mark:|
|[RiggedSimple.dae](https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Models/tree/master/sourceModels/RiggedSimple)|`assimp export RiggedSimple.dae RiggedSimple.glb -glb2`|:x:|
|[RiggedFigure.dae](https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Models/tree/master/sourceModels/RiggedFigure)|`assimp export RiggedFigure.dae RiggedFigure.glb -glb2`|:x:|
|[CesiumMan.dae](https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Models/tree/master/sourceModels/CesiumMan)      |`assimp export CesiumMan.dae CesiumMan.glb -glb2`|:x:|
|[Monster.dae](https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Models/tree/master/sourceModels/Monster)          |`assimp export Monster.dae Monster.glb -glb2`|:x:|

However, if displayed with [glTF Viewer](https://gltf-viewer.donmccurdy.com/), many errors are displayed and the skinning animation will not be displayed correctly.

OS : Windows 10
Compiler : VC++2017
